data.body: Fixed by epic dso-uvyl deep-review remediation (merged to main, v1.17.117): below-threshold detection now emits a distinct 'none' marker value (detection ran, below threshold / not migration-class) instead of overloading 'inconclusive' (which is reserved for sg-unavailable). Contract (migration-class-marker.md) + consumers (task-decomposer.md, apply-two-pass-ordering.sh) updated.
